entities.summary: 55 Cancri Af, also designated Rho1 Cancri f and formally named Harriot, is an exoplanet approximately 41 light-years away from Earth in the constellation of Cancer. 55 Cancri Af is the fourth-known planet from the star 55 Cancri A and the first planet to have been given the designation of "f".
